title: R-AFFORD account snapshots go stale with no scheduled refresh: every real-money promotion (Stage-0 OR live-bar path) is NEEDS_DATA on affordability. MEASURED 2026-11-19 ~02:10Z (committed files on main): comms/mandate_evidence/account_snapshot/bybit_2.json captured_at 2026-11-06T19:59Z (12.2 d) and alpaca_live.json 2026-11-01T11:53Z (17.6 d), against ACCOUNT_SNAPSHOT_MAX_AGE_DAYS=7 in scripts/ops/mandate_resolver.py. Resolver run on trend_donchian_sol_4h S1->S2 bybit_2: NEEDS-DATA R-AFFORD '...is 12.2 days old'. scripts/ops/snapshot_account_for_mandate.py (the v2 writer: per-leg answers, never a balance) has NO caller in .github/workflows, deploy/ or a timer (grep 2026-11-19), so it refreshes only when a session runs it by hand. Fix (Tier 1, tooling): run the writer on a daily schedule (a workflow reading the diag account endpoint, as the writer already does) and commit the per-leg answers; or run it inside the live-bar daily feed job. No new gate (it supplies a measurement the existing clause already reads). Done when both snapshots are < 7 d old on main by a scheduled run, observed twice.
